build_BasicEncoder: build a BasicEncoder feature extractor with 128 output dims and batch normalization
build_SmallEncoder: build a SmallEncoder feature extractor with 128 output dims and group normalization
build_ResidualBlock: build a ResidualBlock with 64 input planes and 128 output planes using group norm
